summary: Iteration 3 tested the new SILVER-PT feature batch (backend and Expo web UI at 390x844). Backend: 21 new pytest tests in test_silverpt_features_v3.py, all passing. The 18 regression tests in test_silverpt_api.py also pass, after 2 test-side fixes (food.jpg fixture missing; jp3 test now lists measurements as trainer because client visibility is OFF by default). Permission rules verified: client gets 403 on hidden measurements and photos; meals and meal history have kcal/macros/grams stripped when nutrition is hidden; nutritionist sees only assigned clients (403 otherwise); team notes are staff-only (403 for client); only the owner can edit or delete a package (404 for others); the client cannot change settings or the nutrition plan. Frontend tested: trainer (home Domande/Storico/Listino, plans history with approach filters, packages, client detail visibility toggles, nutritionist and subscription chips, team notes, agenda calendar with day-N and time-chip-HHMM creating the right appointment, measurement edit with prefilled values and calendar date saving correctly, photo comparison A/B, plan-edit approach chips and active toggle); client (measurements tile hidden, nutrition hidden mode with name-only entry and no numbers, packages with a working WhatsApp link, annual -15%, question create and detail, avatar change button); nutritionist (Clienti and Profilo tabs only, client hub, plan editor saves targets, target bars in diary, diary comment, staff whatsapp/bio, packages button). No red screens and no page errors. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: For a client with nutrition hidden (DCA), only targets are stripped. The meal_plan text with grams (e.g. '80g avena') is still returned and shown. Product decision: keep or hide grams in hidden mode.

In hidden mode a client logs foods by name only (0 kcal). Staff cannot edit a meal to add grams or macros afterwards, so daily totals and target bars stay at 0 for DCA clients. Nutritionist POST/DELETE /meals also returns 403 because trainer_of/assert_access is called without allow_nutri.
subscription is an arbitrary dict. package_id is not checked to exist or to belong to the team.
Default seeding uses check-then-insert_many. Concurrent first calls (the client detail and home screens both fetch it) could seed duplicates. Use an upsert or a unique key/lock.
Archived plans (active=false) are still returned to the client. They are only filtered on the client side in the Home screen.
avatar and staff are not validated: any string, any keys. PUT {avatar:''} stores an empty string instead of removing it.

ui_bugs.issue: A plan with an empty name and no days renders as a blank card (no title fallback).

issues: 'DOMANDE (1)' label wraps onto 2 lines in the quick-action row at 390px width
Birth date is still a free-text AAAA-MM-GG input. Consider reusing the new DatePicker for consistency.

action_items: Decide whether meal_plan grams should be hidden from clients with nutrition visibility OFF (GET /clients/{id}/nutrition plus the nutrition-plan screen for clients).
Add PUT /api/meals/{id} (staff) so a coach or nutritionist can complete name-only meals logged in hidden mode. Allow the nutritionist on meal create/delete if intended.
Make the default package seeding idempotent under concurrency.
Optional: filter archived plans server-side for clients; add a title fallback for unnamed plans on the client Home card.
Code review: server.py is 1080 lines (>700). Split it into routers (auth, clients, nutrition, packages, questions, media).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1080 lines. Split it into modules.
assert_access(allow_nutri=False) is the default in owner_ids/trainer_of. This is good for least privilege, but the nutritionist cannot add meals for assigned clients.

Hidden-mode logic for the client UI reads user.visibility from the auth context. It is refreshed only on Home focus (useFocusEffect refresh), so a toggle change applies after the client returns to Home.

Restored: client visibility (all OFF), nutritionist_id, subscription None, avatar unset, nutrition plan (2200 kcal / 160 g protein, Colazione '80g avena'), edited measurement (79 kg, 2026-11-01), trainer staff.whatsapp unset. The cleanup also deleted older TEST_Other users and TEST_ questions/comments from previous iterations.
